meta.title: Rejecting a second time bounces back as already responded
gaps: Configure the two-step event approval workflow with Asha and Bikram.
Submit the event for approval as Ravi rather than publishing it normally.
Open Asha's mailbox and the original Procol approval email.
Click Reject in the email, compose and send the first rejection with the comment "Too expensive".
Wait for Procol to read the mailbox and process the first rejection.
Click Reject again in the original email, send "Still too expensive", and wait for processing.
Observe the bounce-back stating that a response has already been recorded and verify only the first rejection and comment were applied.
Operate separate Ravi, Asha, and mailbox sessions.
